scope: Six recipient CAST physical presentation gates plus Nine Dragon Fire original HUD failure and focused fix retest. No runtime/tests/phone changes.

recipientEvidence.method: view_image inspection of original uncropped native720x1280 decoded12fps phone frames; sampled activation/contact and release for every item. Does not claim all frames watched or 60fps performance.

recipientReviews.conclusion: Three clearly recognizable blue swirling water orbs sit on each enemy lower torso; former inner empty-gap impact resolved. Faces and HUD clear, fades then clears25.
Blue-white healing lotus/water activation centered on each allied lower body; title/level/HP unobstructed. Healing identity remains readable at smaller size, clear45.
Gold upward arrows and orange fire spiral correctly attach to each ally. Distinct even on red player; clear face and HUD. Former name-strip base overlap resolved; faint release65.
Green wind/leaf U and activation glint surround each ally waist/legs rather than name strip. Sufficient evasion identity, not erased to generic dots. Clear90.
Paired angular stone guards visibly flank each allied body, with central space preserved. Former inside-gap guards resolved. HUD clear;115 shows small retiring remnants above HUD.

Small green funnel and circling wind visibly act on each intended enemy torso. Despite reduced size, funnel identity remains recognizable and no empty-space placement/whole-row blanket occurs. Clear release150.

nineDragonHistory.head: 1d02be839ebc99b098fe592699fec51c5eca2aa4
nineDragonHistory.conclusion: Frames45/55 show clearly readable multiple dragon heads, interwoven fiery bodies and compact ring with no full-screen baseline blast. Central enemy HUD is hidden behind rising dragon/coil; actual failure is cinematic layer ordering, not source/size.70 release and90 cleared. Do not fix by removing dragons or arbitrary shrinking.

nineDragonHistory.head: 7cdebfb2d9bd2a2fcf98b22e4ab559be94e362a9
nineDragonHistory.conclusion: At same rising/peak dragon phases, all three enemy names, levels and HP bars visibly render above fire coils. Allied names/levels/HP/MP also remain readable. Original central-HUD concealment resolved while retaining previously accepted dragon source/size. This retest only reopens prior HUD failure.

qualityClaim: Scoped physical visual acceptance for listed symptoms only. Technical HUD counts/cleanup are supporting inputs and do not substitute this visual inspection. Not whole-game commercial completion, eligibility/damage validation or sustained performance acceptance.
policy: Stop discretionary refinement of passed items. Preserve prior seven PASS casts and all approved persistent states. No exact-nine-head counting gate; actual multiple-dragon/coil/fire-ring readability remains required.
